examples.arabic: وكل مرة بتخلص اجابة بيقول شكرا وبيسأل سؤال جديد
examples.english: And every time an answer finishes, he says "Thank you" and asks a new question.
examples.transliteration: W kol marra betkhallas igaba biyo'ul shukran w biyes'al so'al gideed

examples.arabic: ماما بتقوله مش كل حاجة ليها اجابة دلوقتي يا حبيبي
examples.english: Mom tells him "Not everything has an answer right now, my dear".
examples.transliteration: Mama bet'oloh mesh kol haga leeha egaba delwa'ty ya habibi

examples.arabic: ماما بتجاوب وكل حاجه عندها اجابه
examples.english: Mama answers, and everything has an answer with her.
examples.transliteration: Mama bitgawib wa koll haga andaha egaba
